Global MIN_CUSTOM_MSG_TYPE_ID

pub global MIN_CUSTOM_MSG_TYPE_ID: u64;

The minimum message type ID that custom message handlers may use.

IDs below this value are reserved for current and future aztec.nr built-in message types (notes, partial notes, events, etc). If a message is received with a type ID below this threshold that aztec.nr doesn't recognize as its own, processing will fail with an error instructing the developer to use a higher ID.
